query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park downtown, and he had the best time chasing a frisbee with a group of other puppies. I even stopped by the little bakery next to the park on the way home and picked up a matcha scone that was so buttery and perfectly sweet, I’m already planning to go back for more this Saturday. Oh, and my neighbor just dropped off a jar of homemade strawberry jam she made from fruit in her backyard, I tried a spoonful this morning and it tastes way better than any store-bought jam I’ve ever had. I need to request returns for some delivered orders, for order #W7553978 I want to return the items 4545791457, 3098764622 and 1631806422 with the refund going to credit_card_5902940, and for order #W3239882 I want to return item 9494281769 with the refund also going to credit_card_5902940.
